name: Raiyan Rongon Arnob
bio: I am an undergraduate Electrical and Electronic Engineering student at East West University with a strong passion for Embedded Systems, Robotics, and hardware innovation. I enjoy transforming ideas into practical solutions through hands-on projects and continuous experimentation. My experience includes developing embedded systems, building FPV drones and soccer robots, designing electronic circuits, and simulating systems using MATLAB/Simulink, including 2D floor planning. I am always eager to learn new technologies, solve real-world engineering problems, and improve my skills by building projects that combine electronics, programming, and creativity. Every project is an opportunity to learn something new.
